settings.name: USE_BROTLI
settings.description: **Enable Brotli:** Set to `yes` to enable Brotli compression.

settings.name: BROTLI_TYPES
settings.default: application/atom+xml application/javascript application/json application/rss+xml application/vnd.ms-fontobject application/x-font-opentype application/x-font-truetype application/x-font-ttf application/x-javascript application/xhtml+xml application/xml font/eot font/opentype font/otf font/truetype image/svg+xml image/vnd.microsoft.icon image/x-icon image/x-win-bitmap text/css text/javascript text/plain text/xml
settings.description: **MIME Types:** List of content types that will be compressed with Brotli.

settings.name: BROTLI_MIN_LENGTH
settings.description: **Minimum Size:** The minimum response size (in bytes) for Brotli compression to be applied.

settings.name: BROTLI_COMP_LEVEL
settings.description: **Compression Level:** Level of compression from 0 (no compression) to 11 (maximum compression). Higher values use more CPU.
